title: Outbound inference request
description: The shape of a chat-completions request Tinman sends to the configured provider. Tinman speaks the OpenAI-compatible protocol, so any compatible endpoint serves. The endpoint, model and credential are resolved from the environment or a dotenv file before the request is built. Referenced by features/inference-provider.feature.

url.description: The absolute chat-completions endpoint the request addresses, built from the resolved base URL.

authorization.description: The Authorization header value. The resolved credential is always sent as a bearer token.

model.description: The resolved model identifier the provider is asked to serve.

temperature.description: The sampling temperature from the request's profile. The acronym profile optimizes for novelty and the assistant profile for correctness, so the value is per-profile rather than global.

messages.description: The chat messages, in order. At least one is always present.
